scope: Existing canonical development corpus only; limited scene repertoire, no fresh-test access
visual_diagnostic: Train-only centered ridge alpha1 classifier and cosine nearest-centroid; same fixed-seed permuted-label ridge control; report accuracy and macro recall
acoustic_initialization: Frozen expanded canonical global MLP checkpoint
backbones: EmbeddingGemma2 and Qwen frozen; gradients through Qwen to reader
teacher: One genuine frozen-Qwen generated codec trajectory per training-supported canonical sentence, seed42, cap160; decoded positive controls retained locally
objective: codec0 CE including EOS + 0.1 residual-codebook CE + 0.1 normalized prefix MSE
sampling: Batch1; cycle sorted training-supported classes, seeded random training row within class
development_plan: First row by ID in each of first four supported development categories; first training row; null. Freeze IDs before fitting; compare same baseline and acoustic model
generation: sampled codec0 and residuals, seed42 cap105; no target/text/category files at inference
audio_gate: Generate prescribed bounded development comparison after finite completed acoustic run regardless of prefix MSE; MSE is a diagnostic, not intelligibility acceptance
human_gate: Blinded listening required; keep 96 fresh candidates reserved until development evidence justifies a separate protocol
publication: Generic code and aggregate evidence only; all media-derived data and weights remain local
